title: Page 3
content_zh:
「是……是。」
秘书小姐拔腿准备奔离这暴风圈，他倏地又出声，「等一下，前几天我叫你打电话到意大利艺廊，你打了吗？」
「我……我……」糟糕，脑袋一片空白，她到底打了没？秘书小姐嘴唇颤抖着，如果他再吼一声，她绝对会不顾秘书的专业形象飙泪。
「好了，你出去。」掌尚勇强迫自己压低声音，看她的表情，八成忘了打。
秘书小姐见鬼般的撒腿狂奔，掌尚勇烦躁地拿起文件摔回桌上。
他是长得像鬼是不是？为什么每个秘书见到他都一副他会把她们大卸八块的惊惧神情？
她们怕他，他才受够她们咧！
每个人都像只软绵绵的小白兔，不能大声吼，不能说脏话，要不，会把她们吓得泪眼汪汪，外加吓傻她们的大脑、震碎她们的玻璃心脏……
有没有这么脆弱啊她们？
真是气死人了！他为什么要被关在这上百坪的「小小」的办公室里？
没错，这办公室比起其它小公司的办公地方大上许多，可是和一大片蔚蓝大海比起来，这麻雀大的小地方，还真是令人身心无法舒展开来。
以往这时候，他都在海上享受着冲浪的乐趣。虽然已经入冬，但冬天的强风大浪才是他酷爱的，可现在他连去游泳池游个泳都没时间，哪还敢奢望去海边和强风大浪叫嚣。
这一切，都是掌尚仁那家伙害的！
说什么他要带左金和春静表妹到希腊去向小舅请罪，明明就是自己想带未婚妻去旅游，好啊，他爱玩就去玩，干么还把特助左金一起带去？如果左金在，他也不用面对那些软绵绵的小白兔了。
前阵子他大哥掌尚智从德国回来，原以为他终于可以获得自由到大海里去翻滚，孰料未来大嫂有流产迹象，大哥护妻护子心切，决定和未来大嫂到乡下小住一段时间，所以，在老大、老二都不在的这段期间，他还是得待在公司坐镇。
两个哥哥都要照顾未婚妻，好吧，他就认命点死守总裁办公室，但是，他再也受不了那些动不动就想哭的小白兔了！
他不要女人，他需要的是男人……一个能干、有肩膀的男特助。
但一时片刻，他去哪里找人？
他的那群冲浪朋友，都有各自的工作，就算愿意来，也未必能胜任这份工作。
要找一个能马上胜任特助工作的人……

脑里突然想到最佳人选——就是他！
掌尚勇用力的拍一下手，虽然几百年没联络对方，也不知道对方愿不愿意，但总得试一试，相信凭那人的聪明才智，一定可以解救他脱离苦海。
奇迹，尚未降临。
看着哥哥的手机屏幕上，那张她和哥哥还有母亲三人在意大利米开朗基罗广场雕像前合照的照片，保贝儿倍感心酸，几个月前还活跳跳的一个人，现在却宛若雕像，一动也不动的躺在病床上。
一个月过去了，母亲每天伤心的守在病床旁，她也很难过，但她不能消沉，哥哥的医药费是一笔不小的数目，虽然目前家中经济并不充裕，但她和母亲绝不会放弃哥哥，她们始终相信奇迹会出现，只是需要一点时间。
母亲没心情经营早餐店，而她对早餐店的工作也不熟，前阵子她和母亲商量过后，决定卖掉早餐店，付清一些贷款，手边有一些余钱，可，能撑多久呢？她很是担心。
这几天，她开始找工作，母亲害怕失去哥哥的心情她能了解，就让母亲在医院照顾哥哥，赚钱的事，由她来想办法。
今天，她去拜访过认识的几位教授，请教授帮忙介绍陶艺相关的工作，还去补习班询问是否有缺英文和意大利文的教师工作——
这年头想找份高薪的工作不易，为了哥哥的医药费，她得兼两三份工作才行。
保贝儿累瘫在沙发上，脑袋还在运转，想着自己还可以做什么工作，只要是正当的，她都愿意去做。
手机铃声响起，她只呆了一秒钟，旋即接起发出铃响的手机。
「喂，是保俊吗？我是掌尚勇。」
打电话来的人很猴急，她一接起，他就迫不及待出声。
「喂？请问这是保俊的手机吗？」
「呃，是，是的。」
「可以请保俊听电话吗？」
「这个……我哥目前不方便接电话。」她不确定哥哥是否愿意让朋友知道他现在的状况，若换作是她，她不是很愿意，既然他们是双胞胎，她就暂时当哥哥和她的感觉是相同的。
「那，他什么时候方便？」
「这个……我不确定。」
那端的人顿了半秒，旋即说明打这通电话的来意。

「我是你哥的小学同学，目前是天信集团的代理总裁，我现在缺一个特助，如果你哥愿意，麻烦请他打电话跟我联络。」
天信集团……她好像有听哥哥提过他有个小学同学是天信集团的三公子，可是小学毕业他就到国外念书，从那之后就都没联络了。
保贝儿犹豫要不要告诉他实情，免得耽搁他的时间。
「那个……」
「如果他愿意屈就，底薪十万，另外我会依他工作情形再加奖金……」
这……该不会是诈骗电话吧？
「可是，我哥他……不一定能胜任。」被月薪十万和奖金冲昏了头，保贝儿兴奋到已不管是不是诈骗集团的把戏。
「特助的工作不难，我相信他可以。」
「呃，不好意思，我先确定一下，你说你是我哥的小学同学，那你们多久没见面了？」
「国小毕业到现在。」
「那，多久没联络了？」保贝儿兴奋的掩嘴。
「一样，国小毕业到现在。」电话男不耐烦之余，一想到那些软绵绵的小白兔，不禁又捺着性子解释，「也许你哥不记得我，请你告诉他我是……」忍一时不耐，才能海阔天空。
「掌尚勇嘛，我哥记得你，你是天信集团的三公子。」
「想不到他还记得我。」
「当然记得。」保贝儿开心得想尖叫。「你放心，我一定会转告我哥的，呃，你希望我哥什么时候开始上班？」
「越快越好。」
「那是当然！」她也这么希望，这样医药费就有着落了。
「你什么时候可以联络上你哥？」
「嗯？」
「可以的话，请他现在就来。」掌尚勇连一天都等不及了。

「现在？」
「他在忙？」
「不，他一点都不忙。我一小时后……不，我是说我哥一小时后会到贵公司去报到。」
「好，请他直接到总裁办公室来找我，我等他。」
「好，我知道，我一定会请他马上去的，谢谢。」
关上手机，保贝儿放声尖叫，喜极而泣。她就知道一定会有奇迹，她正愁找不到工作，上帝就赐给她这高薪的工作。
这或许是上帝在考验她，要她为哥哥的苏醒先付出一点代价。
愿意，她愿意，只要哥哥能醒来。
擦干眼泪，她没太多时间在这里多愁善感，首先要做的是——
把一头波浪长发理成小平头。
摸着乌溜溜的秀发，这一头令她引以为傲的黑发，多少意大利男子称赞过它啊……不，不要再想、不能心疼、不能不舍，头发剪掉还可以再长，可月薪十万的工作，错过就不再有。
是的，她要「代兄出征」，前往天信集团取得月薪十万的特助工作。
可以的，保贝儿，你绝对可以的！
为自己信心喊话后，她抓了小皮包冲下楼，先到楼下一位老师傅的理发店，和波浪长发说拜拜。
content_en:
"Yes...yes."
The secretary was about to run away from the storm, but he suddenly said again, "Wait a minute, I asked you to call the Italian Art Gallery a few days ago, did you do it?"
"I...I..." Oops, my mind went blank. Did she hit him? The secretary's lips trembled. If he yelled again, she would definitely burst into tears regardless of the secretary's professional image.
"Okay, get out." Zhang Shangyong forced himself to lower his voice. Looking at her expression, he probably forgot to hit her.
The secretary ran away like a ghost, Zhang Shangyong picked up the documents and threw them back on the table in annoyance.
Does he look like a ghost? Why did every secretary look terrified when they saw him that he would tear them into pieces?
They were afraid of him, so he had had enough of them!
Everyone is like a soft little white rabbit. They cannot yell loudly or say bad words, otherwise it will scare them to tears, frighten their brains, and shatter their glass hearts...
Are they that fragile?
It’s so infuriating! Why is he locked up in this "tiny" office measuring over a hundred square meters?
Yes, this office is much larger than the offices of other small companies, but compared with the vast blue sea, this small place the size of a sparrow is really hard to relax physically and mentally.
At this time in the past, he was enjoying surfing on the sea. Although it has already entered winter, he loves the strong winds and waves in winter, but now he doesn't even have time to go to the swimming pool for a swim, so how can he dare to go to the beach and roar with the strong winds and waves.
All of this was caused by that guy Zhang Shangren!
He said he wanted to take cousin Zuo Jin and Chunjing to Greece to plead guilty to his uncle. He obviously wanted to take his fiancée on a trip. Well, he could go and have fun if he wanted to, so why did he bring his special assistant Zuo Jin with him? If Zuo Jin was here, he wouldn't have to face those soft little white rabbits.
His eldest brother, Zhang Shangzhi, came back from Germany a while ago. He originally thought that he would finally be free to roll in the sea. Unexpectedly, his future sister-in-law showed signs of miscarriage. The eldest brother was eager to protect his wife and child, so he decided to live with his future sister-in-law in the countryside for a while. Therefore, during the period when the eldest and second children were away, he still had to stay in the company.
Both brothers have to take care of their fiancées. Well, he will accept his fate and stick to the CEO's office, but he can no longer stand those little white rabbits who want to cry at every turn!
He doesn't want a woman, he wants a man...a capable male assistant with strong shoulders.
But for a moment, where could he find someone?
His group of surfing friends all have their own jobs, and even if they are willing to come, they may not be qualified for the job.
Looking for someone who can immediately take on the special assistant job...
The best candidate suddenly came to mind - it was him!
Zhang Shangyong clapped his hands vigorously. Although he had not contacted the other party for hundreds of years and did not know whether the other party was willing, he had to give it a try. I believed that with that person's intelligence, he would be able to rescue him from the sea of ​​suffering.
The miracle has not yet come.
Looking at the photo on her brother's mobile phone screen of her, her brother and her mother in front of the statue in Michelangelo Square in Italy, Bao Beier felt very sad. A person who was alive and kicking a few months ago was now like a statue, lying motionless on the hospital bed.
A month has passed, and my mother sits beside the hospital bed sadly every day. She is also very sad, but she cannot be depressed. Her brother's medical expenses are a large amount of money. Although the family is not financially wealthy at present, she and her mother will never give up on her brother. They always believe that miracles will happen, but it just takes a little time.
Her mother is not in the mood to run a breakfast shop, and she is not familiar with the work of a breakfast shop. After discussing with her mother a while ago, she decided to sell the breakfast shop, pay off some loans, and have some spare money on hand, but how long can it last? She was very worried.
In the past few days, she has started to look for a job. She can understand her mother's fear of losing her brother., let her mother take care of her brother in the hospital, and let her figure out how to make money.
Today, she visited several professors she knew and asked them to help introduce ceramics-related jobs. She also went to a cram school to ask if there were any shortage of English and Italian teaching jobs——
It's not easy to find a high-paying job these days. To pay for her brother's medical expenses, she has to hold two or three jobs.
Bao Beier collapsed on the sofa with exhaustion, her mind still running, thinking about what other jobs she could do. As long as it was legitimate, she was willing to do it.
The phone rang, and she only stayed for a second before picking up the ringing phone.
"Hey, is this Baojun? I'm Zhang Shangyong."
The caller was very anxious, and as soon as she picked up the call, he couldn't wait to speak.
"Hello? Is this Baojun's cell phone?"
"Uh, yes, yes."
"Can you ask Bojun to answer the phone?"
"Well... it's not convenient for my brother to answer the phone right now." She wasn't sure whether her brother was willing to let his friends know his current situation. If it were her, she wouldn't be very willing. Since they are twins, she feels the same as her brother for the time being.
"Then, when is it convenient for him?"
"Well...I'm not sure."
The person on the other end paused for half a second and then explained the purpose of the call.
"I am your brother's elementary school classmate. I am currently the acting president of Tianxin Group. I am currently in need of a special assistant. If your brother is willing, please ask him to call me."
Tianxin Group... She seemed to have heard her brother mention that he had a primary school classmate who was the third son of Tianxin Group, but he went to study abroad after graduating from primary school, and he had no contact with her since then.
Bao Beier hesitated to tell him the truth so as not to waste his time.
"That..."
"If he is willing to give in, he will get a basic salary of 100,000, and I will add bonuses based on his work situation..."
Is this... a scam call?
"But, my brother... may not be qualified." Being carried away by the monthly salary of 100,000 yuan and the bonus, Bao Beier was so excited that she no longer cared whether it was a trick of a fraud group.
"The job of a special assistant is not difficult, I believe he can do it."
"Uh, sorry, let me make sure first. You said you were my brother's elementary school classmate. How long has it been since you last met?"
"I graduated from elementary school until now."
"So, how long have you been without contact?" Bao Beier covered her mouth in excitement.
"Same, I graduated from elementary school until now." The man on the phone was impatient, but when he thought of those soft little white rabbits, he couldn't help but explain, "Maybe your brother doesn't remember me, please tell him that I am..." Only by enduring impatience can the world be brighter.
"Zhang Shangyong, my brother remembers you. You are the third son of Tianxin Group."
"I didn't expect he still remembered me."
"Of course I remember." Bao Beier was so happy that she wanted to scream. "Don't worry, I will definitely tell my brother. Um, when do you want my brother to start working?"
"The sooner the better."
"Of course!" She also hoped so, so that the medical expenses would be settled.
"When can you contact your brother?"
"Huh?"
"If possible, please ask him to come now." Zhang Shangyong couldn't wait even a day.
"Now?"
"Is he busy?"
"No, he is not busy at all. I will report to your company in one hour... no, I mean my brother will report to your company in one hour."
"Okay, please ask him to come to me directly in the president's office. I'll wait for him."
"Okay, I know, I will definitely ask him to go right away, thank you."
Turning off the phone, Bao Beier screamed loudly and cried with joy. She knew there would be a miracle. She was worried about not being able to find a job, so God gave her this high-paying job.
This may be God testing her, asking her to pay a price for her brother's awakening.
Yes, she is willing, as long as her brother wakes up.
Wipe away her tears. She doesn’t have much time to be sentimental here. The first thing to do is——
Put one endThe long wavy hair is cut into a crew cut.
Touching her black hair, which she was proud of, how many Italian men had praised it... No, don't think about it, don't feel bad, and can't let it go. If you cut your hair, it can grow longer, but if you miss a job with a monthly salary of 100,000 yuan, it will no longer exist.
Yes, she wants to "go on behalf of her brother" and go to Tianxin Group to get a special assistant job with a monthly salary of 100,000 yuan.
Yes, Baby, you absolutely can!
After shouting for her confidence, she grabbed her small purse and rushed downstairs. She first went to the barber shop of an old master downstairs to say goodbye to her wavy hair.
